correctness.rationale: Proof reconstructed and checked: for each nonedge i,j, the 10-norm witness has Dirichlet energy u_i+b_i+u_j+b_j <=2, giving SLEM>=4/5. Balanced K_{m,...,m} core adjacency eigenvalues d,0,-m yield exact 2x2 blocks: B_d has (1,1/5), B_0 has (4/5,-1/5), and both 4I +/-5B_{-m} are PSD for every r>=2. Equality at a complete-bipartite core forces b=2/5, zero core holding and a common cross-part weight; both row constraints demand p=q. For star cores the center row sum exceeds 1. Exact standalone checker passed 9681 Rayleigh checks, 36 full constructed matrices and spectral-block checks, and 156 unequal parameter incompatibilities. These finite checks are not the infinite proof.

evidence: Boyd et al. (2007) prove general automorphism/SDP reductions; no analytic private-leaf corona theorem is stated in inspected sections.

Jafarizadeh (2020, later OA manuscript arxiv:2501.02421) proves invariance under clique lift, which replaces base vertices by cliques with complete cross-block edges. A one-leaf corona has no such complete cross-block adjacency.
broader_coverage.reasoning: General algorithms solve each finite instance but do not logically supply the claimed closed constant, universal lower bound or balance iff. Clique lifting creates cross-edges incident to all clone vertices, whereas a private leaf is adjacent only to its own core vertex, so the stated reduction is not directly applicable.

value.rationale: The four-coordinate spectral obstruction applies to arbitrary noncomplete core graphs independently of automorphisms and is sharp for every balanced complete multipartite core (a natural unbounded network family). The exact bipartite balance iff discriminates attainable and unattainable cases, with a unique fully specified optimum in the balanced case. It is a structural infinite-family mixing design result rather than an arbitrary small benchmark or parameter restatement; a previously covered C4 special case is excluded from the novel scope.
